data.situation: On Monday, Lin began work at the same service centre. The staff board beside the doorway showed two shifts, with different names under morning and afternoon. Two colleagues waved her over. A brown envelope lay in the middle of the desk, holding forms for Friday's room booking. The morning receptionist had checked the date but had not called the group. Everyone thought someone else would do it. Lin looked from the envelope to the board and saw how a small task could fall between two working periods. Her duty today was to call visitors. She said, "I will take responsibility for calling the group." One colleague wrote her name on a card to the right of the envelope. Lin added what was finished and what still needed doing. Then she made the call before lunch and marked it complete. The envelope stayed in the same place for the afternoon team, but now it carried a name and a clear next step.
data.zhSupport: 沿轮班表、信封、签名卡回想。duty 是工作职责，responsibility 说明谁承担处理事情的责任；staff 是集合名词，colleagues 和 shifts 保留原资料复数形式。同事与轮班名称先辅助识别，交接时优先说清负责人和具体任务。
data.easySummary: A phone call is unfinished. Lin tells the team she will make it. She writes her name and finishes before lunch.
data.easySummaryZh: 一通电话还没打。林告诉团队这件事由她来做，写下自己的名字，并在午饭前完成。

glossary.note: 一起工作的人；保留种子词原复数，不把它改写为新的原资料词项。
属于本人工作的任务；本课不使用关税义。
本课在前台接待来访者并处理预订的人；原记录没有英文上下文。
处理某事的责任；本课用 take responsibility for 说明谁负责。
原资料复数名词，表示不同的工作时间段；不是动词移动。
组织中工作的人，集合名词；本课不当成一个人的职位。
for 后可接名词或动词 ing 形式；声明负责后仍需完成实际任务。

retrievalPrompts.cue: A visitor asks why you are making calls today. Explain that this is part of your job.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 来访者问你今天为何负责打电话。说明这是你今天工作职责的一部分。
acceptableAnswers: It is my duty to call the visitors today.
My duty today is to call the visitors.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Name the task as part of your job.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 把具体任务与工作职责联系起来。

retrievalPrompts.function: Name the person at the desk
retrievalPrompts.cue: A caller needs to check a room booking with the person who welcomes visitors at the desk. Say who can help.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 来电的人要找前台接待来访者的人核对预订。告诉他应找谁。
acceptableAnswers: The receptionist can help you check the room booking.
Please ask the receptionist about your booking.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Use the job name for the person at the front desk.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 用前台接待人员的职位名称。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Your workmates are unsure who will call the group. Tell them that you will do it.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 同事们不确定谁会打电话通知小组。告诉他们这件事由你负责。
acceptableAnswers: I will take responsibility for calling the group.
I will take responsibility for calling the group. Please tell our other colleagues.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Give an owner and a task. After for, calling names the action.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 说清负责人和任务；for 后用 calling 表示动作。

transferPrompt.function: Take ownership in a new group
transferPrompt.cue: At a volunteer event, nobody has collected the chairs. Tell the team that you will do this before the visitors arrive.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 换到志愿活动：还没人收好椅子。告诉团队，你会在来访者到达前负责这件事。
acceptableAnswers: I will take responsibility for collecting the chairs before the visitors arrive.
I can take responsibility for collecting the chairs. I will finish before the visitors arrive.
transferPrompt.feedback: Name a new action and a time. The same structure can work outside paid employment.
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 说清新任务与完成时间；这个结构也可以用于志愿活动。
